newsitem.title: GREECE: RIZOS NAMED GENL DIRECTOR OF GREECE'S ACCOUNTING OFFICE.
newsitem.headline: RIZOS NAMED GENL DIRECTOR OF GREECE'S ACCOUNTING OFFICE.

text.p: Dionysios Rizos was promoted to the position of general director at Greece's general accounting office, finance ministry sources told Reuters. He was formerly director of the public debt department.
The position was vacant since Dimitris Dritsas retired. Dritsas is currently the finance ministry's special general director of public debt. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
